test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All parrots are eagles.

Some parrots are ostriches.

Conclusions:

(I) Some eagles are parrots.

(II) Some eagles are ostriches.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

All parrots are eagles.

Some parrots are ostriches.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d230322ccae2cfe08f22045d43d992ce23ffef08f6b068a54c8750f54a358795.png] 

**Conclusions**:

(I) Some eagles are parrots - True(Because, All parrots are eagles is given, it implies that some eagles are parrots).

(II) Some eagles are ostriches - True(Because, All parrots are eagles and Some parrots are ostriches, it implies that the some eagles are ostriches as well).

Thus, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**
